doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23

title: When Laine first played funerals and how long they lasted
summary: Laine cannot date his start with funerals; he and his wife say music at funerals was cut out after just a few years.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: Must be positively sold. Because your pictures will show you. That's right. Yeah, yeah. When did you first start playing Funerals? When did you first start playing Funerals? When you first start playing Funerals. When I first, oh, now, I can't answer that because I really don't remember. No, he knows.
I don't remember. Can't answer it. Well, do you think?
But God only knows, I played them.

Played a lot of them, huh? I played them, all right. There's a lot of men who are living today that can bear me out to the truth with that. They're all over the river, lots of them. Right today, living. Did you play them for many years? Did you play Funerals for many, many years?
They didn't play music for funerals too long, did they?
No, no, no. No, I remember that. No, no, they didn't. No, they didn't. No, they cut that out. They cut it out.
